name: 48317 · Shelby Twp, MI
findings: ZIP 48317 (Shelby Twp) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 30 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48317 (Shelby Twp) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48317 (Shelby Twp) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
